question: The ancient city of Dholavira, is located in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ancient city of Dholavira **is located in the state of** Gujarat**.
 
• Dholavira is one of the largest and most prominent archaeological sites in India, belonging to the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• The city was discovered in 1967-68 by archaeologist Jagat Pati Joshi, and since then, several excavations have been conducted to uncover its rich history.
 
• The Tropic of Cancer is where Dholavira is located.
 
• It is the most well-known Indus Valley Civilization archeological site in India and one of the five biggest Harappan sites.
 
• It is situated on Khadir Bet Island in the Great Rann of Kutch's Kutch Desert Wildlife Sanctuary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is a state in central India known for its rich cultural heritage and diverse wildlife. It does not have any significant ancient city belonging to the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• **Rajasthan** is a state in northwestern India known for its historical forts, palaces, and temples. It has several ancient sites belonging to the Indus Valley Civilization, such as Kalibangan and Ganeriwala, but not Dholavira.
 
• **Karnataka** is a state in southern India known for its rich history, art, and literature. It does not have any significant ancient city belonging to the Indus Valley Civilization.
